name: repair_unrendered_ref
prompt: This playbook ran on the box and reported success, but the FortiGate step blocked the wrong thing -- the run log shows it was handed the literal text `vars.steps.Analyst_IP_Action.input.target_ip` as the address, not the IP the analyst typed. Find the defect and return the corrected complete YAML. Change nothing else.
notes: Fourth repair defect class and a near-twin of repair_bad_step_ref, deliberately kept separate so the two do not collapse: there the braces are present and the NAME inside is wrong (empty value); here the path is right but the `{{ }}` are absent, so FSR never renders it and passes the template source through verbatim. Empty vs literal are different symptoms with different fixes. Compiles and verifies clean -- a bare string is a legal param value -- so only a diagnosis that names the missing render, not a static gate, catches it. The tempting wrong fix is to delete the reference or the step, caught by no_collateral_damage.

ir_assertions.note: the block reads the analyst's IP through a RENDERED reference
the block step is still there
the gate still precedes the block -- a fix must not reroute it
